title: fix(cli): preserve double dash before the entrypoint
body:
Deno 2.9.6 regressed handling of `--` before the first positional:
`deno run -- script.ts`, `deno eval -- code`, and bare `deno -- script.ts`
put the entrypoint into trailing args instead of accepting it as the script
path, because the parser entered trailing mode on the first `--`.

For entrypoint-style commands (a single-value positional followed by
trailing var args: run/watch/serve/eval/task/compile), a `--` seen before
any positional now switches the parser into a positional-only mode: the
remaining args fill the positionals literally, so the entrypoint may start
with a hyphen, and then the command's normal trailing-argument handling
resumes. A second `--` is forwarded literally, matching clap where only the
first separator is special. Commands that used clap's `.last(true)`
(test/bench/install/create), where args after `--` are script args that
bypass the positionals, keep their current behavior, as do commands with a
`.trailing()` positional (init/create/x).

Supersedes #36794 with the `.last(true)` commands excluded.

Fixes #36792

Co-authored-by: Tiancheng Xu <44307608+Tiancheng-Xu@users.noreply.github.com>
